caseType: real historical listing, not a current housing recommendation

identifiers.bblMethod: Borough 1 + five-digit block 00070 + four-digit lot 0032, corroborated by the historical NYC list.

sources.title: 180 Water Street #312 — RentHop historical listing
sources.freshness: Parallel returned an older snapshot despite live fetch being allowed. TinyFish refresh was bot-blocked. Exa returned the same historical status and core terms; its acquisition time was not supplied.
sources.summary: Archived lease takeover with gross and net rent, a concession, known fees, and unit amenities. Body still invites immediate occupancy. RentHop recommendations are separate properties.

sources.title: Aqua House NYC — 180 Water Street marketing site
sources.summary: Identifies the 180 Water Street address and markets a rooftop pool, fitness center, concierge, and in-unit laundry. Does not establish current pool operations, access price, or unit availability.
sources.independentCorroboration: Separate publisher from RentHop; still a marketing claim rather than an inspection.

sources.title: 180 Water Street — RentHop building summary
sources.summary: Building narrative says there is no swimming pool, contrary to the building marketing site and the archived unit description. Same publisher as S1, so not independent corroboration.

sources.title: HPD Online — building 29370 overview
sources.summary: Direct extraction confirms 180 Water Street, Manhattan, ZIP 10038, building 29370, BIN 1001134, block 70, lot 32, active registration. Sections show retrieval errors. Counts are not accepted as verified.

sources.title: 2020 NYC Benchmarking Covered Buildings List
sources.scope: building address and tax-lot identity only
sources.summary: Row associates 180 WATER STREET in Manhattan with BBL 1000700032. Used only as historical corroboration of identity; not evidence of current compliance, violations, or occupancy.

listingClaims.availabilityNow: Unknown; do not present as active

calculations.name: Original-term net effective rent
assumptions: Original 19-month term; full one-month concession; excludes all fees.
calculations.limits: Advertised 4730 differs by about 0.74 per month. Small rounding difference, not evidence of fraud. Takeover concession entitlement remains unknown.

calculations.name: Known recurring amount for one leaseholder before unknown costs
assumptions: One leaseholder; gross rent plus listed amenity fee; no assumed concession allocation.
calculations.limits: Not all-in cost. Insurance, electricity and other undisclosed charges remain unknown. Historical advertised terms only.

calculations.name: Listed upfront subtotal for one applicant
assumptions: First month, one deposit, one application fee.
calculations.limits: Not a complete move-in bill. Amenity fee timing, other charges, and takeover deposit transfer must be confirmed; refundable deposit is cash outlay, not rent expense.

findings.label: Supported by supplied evidence
findings.finding: Expired page status and immediate-move-in body text coexist.
findings.implication: Do not expose an Apply or Available Now action for this case.

findings.label: Inferred
findings.finding: The original lease average does not establish the effective rent for a new takeover renter.
findings.implication: Request remaining term, concession schedule, and written transfer terms.

findings.label: Supported by supplied evidence
findings.finding: Building marketing advertises a pool; RentHop building narrative denies one.
findings.implication: Prefer the building's direct statement for advertised amenities, but actual operation and access conditions remain unknown.

findings.label: Supported by supplied evidence
findings.finding: The initial search excerpt included 4795 USD and 577 square feet from nearby unit 3109 at 116 John Street. Full page structure separates this card from the target description.
findings.implication: Do not treat nearby cards as target-unit fields or as a target price conflict.

findings.label: Unknown
findings.finding: HPD sections returned errors. Browser summary reported counts, but follow-up extraction could not confirm them.
findings.implication: Keep open violations and complaint totals null; do not infer a clean record or transfer another unit's issue to 312.

rejectedToolConclusions: TinyFish constructed BBL 1001133200 from a BIN; these are different identifiers. Retain BBL 1000700032 from block/lot and historical official corroboration.
TinyFish described 10 complaint rows as 10 complaints, but its table repeats a complaint ID. No verified unique count is retained.
TinyFish reported zero open violations alongside a server error. Zero is not accepted as a verified current count.
officialRecords.unverifiedObservations: Browser summary described a complaint in another apartment. It is not evidence about unit 312, and no building safety conclusion is drawn.

questions: Is apartment 312 actually available now, and can management supply the current listing and written terms?
What is the remaining lease term, and does the incoming tenant receive the original free month or any unused concession?
What amounts are payable each month, and when is any concession credited?
What fees, insurance, utilities, and deposit-transfer amounts apply to this takeover?
Is the rooftop pool operating, who may use it, and are access fees or seasonal restrictions separate?
Is a flex partition permitted for this specific unit, and what layout, installation, and restoration conditions apply?
